title: Leveraging Chameleon Cloud for Hands-On Learning in Systems and Data Courses: An Experience Report
summary: FOUNT's experience report on four courses in storage systems, data analysis and ML operations taught on Chameleon, with lessons for instructors. With F. Fund, E. Zadok, T. Estro, D. Koop and K. Keahey.

title: Practical Evaluation Methods for Scientific Instruments
venue: PEARC '26 (Practice and Experience in Advanced Research Computing)
summary: Evaluation methods for experimental cyberinfrastructure, drawn from 10 years of Chameleon operations. I led the publications analysis, combining Google Scholar, Scopus and Semantic Scholar with user reports to trace about 1,200 publications to the platform, and managed the submission. With K. Keahey, P. Marshall, M. Powers, M. Sherman and D. Stanzione.

title: The Cost of Teaching Operational ML
summary: From FOUNT: a large MLOps course taught on Chameleon, the AWS and GCP cost of the same resources, and the tradeoffs of teaching on commercial versus research clouds. With F. Fund, K. Keahey, C. Hammock, M. Powers and M. Sherman.

title: Chameleon Concierge: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) To Enhance Open Testbed Documentation
summary: Poster on Chameleon Concierge, the RAG documentation assistant I scoped and supervised. With S. A. Zada, the summer student who built the first prototype, and K. Keahey.

title: Summer of Reproducibility: Building Global Capacity for Practical Reproducibility through Hands-On Mentorship
venue: ACM Conference on Reproducibility and Replicability (ACM REP '25)
summary: On REPETO's mentorship program, which paired 55+ students with 60+ mentors on reproducibility challenges. With S. Lieggi, F. Fund and K. Keahey.

title: FOUNT Courselets on the National Data Platform
summary: Bringing FOUNT's educational courselets to the National Data Platform. With P. Ramonetti, M. Floca and K. Keahey.

title: Report on Challenges of Practical Reproducibility for Systems and HPC Computer Science
summary: The REPETO community workshop report: the obstacles to reproducing systems and HPC experiments, and recommended practices. I co-authored it as second author, with K. Keahey, R. Tolosana Calasanz, S. Hunold, J. Lofstead, T. Malik and C. Perez.

title: A Longitudinal Study of the Prevalence of WiFi Bottlenecks in Home Access Networks
summary: Uses data from our resident-hosted measurement devices to show how often in-home Wi-Fi, rather than the broadband connection, limits home internet performance. With R. Sharma and N. Feamster.

title: Discovery Testbed: An Observational Instrument for Broadband Research
summary: Describes the testbed behind FLOTO: a national fleet of measurement devices that researchers and communities can use to study broadband performance. With K. Keahey, N. Feamster, G. Martins, M. Powers, A. Schrubbe and M. Sherman.

title: Benchmarks or Equity? A New Approach to Measuring Internet Performance
summary: From the Internet Equity Initiative: why measuring internet performance against fixed speed benchmarks misses inequities, and an alternative approach. With R. Sharma, T. Mangla, J. Saxon, N. Feamster and N. Marwell.

title: Best Practices for Collecting Speed Test Data
summary: Practical guidance on collecting and interpreting speed test data for broadband policy. With K. MacMillan, T. Mangla and N. Feamster.
